note: Legal diligence request list. phase: phase1 (core documents; organize and run public searches), phase2 (counsel review, consents and deeper items), decision (needed by the go/no-go date). when: tags for items that apply only to some deals; drop with --exclude. Tags: stock-purchase (items needed only in a stock purchase), real-estate, leased-premises, employees, software, regulated, franchise, vehicles, government-contracts, environmental-risk.

requests.request: Entity documents: formation certificate, operating agreement or bylaws, all amendments, ownership ledger or cap table
requests.why: Who owns the business and who can sign the sale

requests.request: Certificate of good standing from the state of formation and each state where the business operates
requests.why: Entity is active and current on filings

requests.request: Owner or board consents approving the sale, and any spouse consent if the state requires it
requests.why: Authority to sell; counsel confirms what's needed

requests.request: Minutes, resolutions and any buy-sell or shareholder agreements
requests.why: Hidden rights of other owners, prior commitments

requests.request: List of all contracts with customers, suppliers, distributors, subcontractors and partners above a set dollar amount, with copies
requests.why: Contract inventory; counsel checks assignment and change-of-control terms

requests.request: Copies of the top 10 customer contracts, purchase orders or standing terms (or confirmation that none exist in writing)
requests.why: Revenue that depends on contracts the buyer may need consent to take over

requests.request: Supplier and vendor agreements for critical inputs, including any exclusive or minimum-purchase terms
requests.why: Supply continuity and commitments

requests.request: Premises lease, all amendments, renewal notices, estoppel or subordination agreements, and landlord contact
requests.why: Location continuity; counsel checks assignment terms and personal guarantees

requests.request: Landlord consent to assignment, or new lease terms, as a closing item
requests.why: Common condition to closing and often lender-required

requests.request: Deed, title report, survey and any mortgage on owned real estate
requests.why: What is being bought and what encumbers it

requests.request: Equipment leases, vehicle leases and financing agreements
requests.why: Debt-like items and consents to transfer

requests.request: Vehicle titles and registrations
requests.why: Owner of record; titled to the owner personally or the company

requests.request: List of every license, permit, registration and certification (issuer, holder, number, expiry), with copies
requests.why: Which ones transfer, which must be reissued, and how long that takes

requests.request: Professional or trade licenses held personally by the owner or employees that the business depends on
requests.why: A license tied to a person may leave with them

requests.request: Inspection reports, notices of violation, and correspondence with regulators or licensing boards, last 5 years
requests.why: Compliance history and open issues

requests.request: Litigation and claims schedule: pending, threatened or settled in the last 5 years, including demand letters and agency complaints
requests.why: Known liabilities; compare with public court searches

requests.request: Insurance claims history related to any lawsuits (cross-reference loss runs)
requests.why: Whether claims were covered

requests.request: Tax notices, audits, liens or payment plans with any taxing authority, last 5 years
requests.why: Tax exposure; some taxes can follow the business

requests.request: Buyer-run public searches: state and federal court dockets, UCC and tax liens, judgments, business registration, licensing board discipline (logged)
requests.why: Independent check against seller disclosures

requests.request: Trademarks, trade names, assumed name (DBA) filings and any registrations
requests.why: Right to use the name after closing

requests.request: Domain names, website hosting, social media accounts, phone numbers and online review profiles: list with the account holder of record
requests.why: Accounts held in the owner's personal name must be transferred

requests.request: Software and code: licenses for key software, any custom code with who wrote it and written assignments from contractors
requests.why: Ownership and transferability of the systems the business runs on

requests.request: Customer data and privacy: where it's stored, privacy policy, any breaches or complaints
requests.why: Data transfer and compliance exposure

requests.request: Environmental: permits, disclosures, prior reports, storage tanks, hazardous materials handled
requests.why: Contamination liability; lender may require a report

requests.request: Ask the lender whether it requires an environmental report and who orders it
requests.why: Lender requirement sets scope and timing

requests.request: Franchise agreement, franchisor transfer requirements and approval timeline
requests.why: Franchisor consent is a closing condition

requests.request: Government contracts and certifications (set-aside status), with novation or recertification requirements
requests.why: Some do not survive a change of owner

requests.request: Employee agreements: offer letters, non-competes, confidentiality, commission plans, handbook
requests.why: Commitments the buyer inherits or must replace

requests.request: Employment claims: wage, discrimination, workers' comp, unemployment disputes, last 5 years
requests.why: Employment liabilities

requests.request: Questions-for-counsel memo delivered to buyer's lawyer
requests.why: Counsel reviews flagged items before the decision

requests.request: Counsel's view on open legal issues recorded
requests.why: Input to the go/no-go decision and purchase agreement
